items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Well these days, Ray Drummond, who was on this recording, I was lucky enough to catch him for this, Ray Drummond, Rufus Reid, Jimmy Rowser, when he can make it, Jimmy Rowser is still playing, Paul West.

ctx.x: Who’s the first five people you call for bass players, for a gig like that?

Well these days, Ray Drummond, who was on this recording, I was lucky enough to catch him for this, Ray Drummond, Rufus Reid, Jimmy Rowser, when he can make it, Jimmy Rowser is still playing, Paul West.
That’s a name I don’t know, but I trust he must be pretty good if he’s on your A list.
